description: The Municipality of Messina publishes geographic information about its cycle routes. The catalogue lists a JSON resource alongside illustrated descriptions of urban and coastal routes, photograph archives and DWG design material. These geometric inputs can help represent active-mobility links in local network and capacity-planning studies. The source does not establish a complete routing graph, cycle counts or the current construction and operating status of every depicted section. The two entries labelled as different 3D projects currently point to the same distribution URL, so their labels do not prove distinct files. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution, with the version unstated in the inspected metadata. Coverage is the municipality, but survey dates and positional accuracy are unknown. Related public-transport records describe a different mode; the source does not supply a documented transfer or connectivity relationship to those networks.
